d: Watch this video as Firstpost explores how Burkina Faso’s military leader Captain Ibrahim Traoré is capturing imaginations across borders through entertainment, viral moments, and a powerful message of African sovereignty, self-reliance, and resource control. Ghanaian actor and filmmaker Kwadwo Nkansah, known as Lil Win, recently shared images hosting a Burkinabè visitor identified as Cadafi—described by the actor as Traoré’s personal bodyguard, a claim questioned online by users pointing to Burkina Faso’s Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (VDP) and not yet independently verified…
